source.paper: M. Malinowski et al., Probing the limits of correlations in an indivisible quantum system (2018)

selection.apparatus: Single trapped calcium-40 ion; five observables; gen = full modular pulse sequence, not the shortened concatenated sho protocol.
selection.rule: The lower median of the distinct pulse times, selected before inspecting the raw numerical rows. No optimization of angle or selection by outcomes. Not the paper's nearest-to-compatibility Table I rule.
selection.assignment: First/second in chronological order; dark = -1 (bit 0), bright = +1 (bit 1). Bright iff PMT photon count >= 7; this reproduces the archived block means rather than optimizing a witness.
selection.weights: Equal weight per event within each edge. Sum five normalized edge contributions, one for each setting, each with 10000 archived shots in an order. No outcomes discarded in this replay.
